title: Blind annotation packets
question: What self-contained inputs does each blind pass receive (D7 §3.2 golden mode, packet only, offset probe, adjudication)?
method: Generated input folders: guideline, model, schema, format, unit packets, pages, instructions. Outputs narrowed on 2026-10-28 from the whole inputs folder to these five, after the Sonnet copies (golden_sg, packet_only_sp, adjudication_d7_s; records s0.pass-sg, s0.pass-sp, s0.adjudication-d7-sonnet) were added beside them; the five hashed together to the originally recorded value before narrowing.
conclusion: One input folder per pass; golden_h copies A's inputs for the Haiku control; adjudication_d7 carries both passes and their alignment diff.
